pages.title: Curing
pages.text: A golden apple should bring a villager back. The device takes the apple and draws away the weakness, holding that unfinished change in its pattern.

pages.title: Putting It to Work
pages.text: $(l)Name a zombie villager$(), weaken it, then drop a golden apple nearby. After a treatment’s wait, aether emerges; the zombie remains. Each cycle needs fresh weakness and another apple. Keep it close while the device works.
